details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 1 - The Apprentices · Seat 1, Front line

A huge, cheerful farm lad with a greatsword, a borrowed coat of boiled leather and absolutely no indoor voice. Loud, warm and hopelessly honest; his whisper is everyone else's shout, and he thinks most problems are doors to be shouldered. Joined the Keepers so that one day a song might be sung about a Harrow; his mam has already stitched his name inside his cloak.

In a fight

Wade in, swing at the biggest goblin first (Advantage on your first greatsword swing each round), and Cleave into the next one when it drops.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Weapon Specialisation (Greatsword). Advantage on the first attack roll you make with your greatsword each round, and +1 damage with it (included above).

Combat Reflexes. Once per round, make an Attack of Opportunity (one melee attack) against an enemy you can see that leaves your reach or moves past or through it. Disengage prevents it. This uses your one reaction for the round.

Combat Manoeuvres. Each replaces one attack. Trip: your Str or Dex check vs its Str or Dex, win and it falls Prone. Disarm: Str contest, win and it drops its weapon. Grapple: Str contest, win and it is Restrained. Dirty Trick: your Dex check vs its Dex or Wis check (its choice), win and it is Blinded until the end of its next turn (once per foe per fight). Push: on a hit, shove a creature up to one size larger than you 10ft instead of dealing damage. Cleave: when you drop a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, make one extra melee attack (same bonus) at a different creature in reach, once per turn. Shield Blow (with your buckler): attack with Disadvantage, replacing all your attacks this round; on a hit the target makes a Fortitude save (DC 14) or is Stunned for 1d2 rounds, and a creature that saves is immune to it for the fight. Ties go to the defender. Manoeuvre save DC 14.

Intimidating Strike (Fighter manoeuvre). Replaces one attack. On a hit, the target makes a Will save (DC 14) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn: Disadvantage on attacks and checks while it can see you, and it cannot move closer to you.

Charge and Guard (actions). Charge: declare before moving; move up to 60ft in a straight line (at least 10ft) and make one attack with Advantage, but attacks against you have Advantage until your next turn. Guard: replaces all your attacks; pick an adjacent ally, and attacks against it have Disadvantage until your next turn while you stay next to it.

Crushing Blow (Heavy Hand kit). Reroll 1s and 2s on the damage dice of two-handed weapons (your greatsword).

Breaker (Heavy Hand kit). Advantage on Strength checks to break, smash or force objects (a wooden door is DC 12, an iron or barred door DC 15).

Human. Medium size, speed 30ft, no darkvision.

Knack: Sneaking. Advantage on Dexterity checks to move quietly or hide (chosen skill; not an NWP slot). Surprisingly light on his feet for his size.

Extra General Feat. Took Steady Hand at 1st level (see Feats).

Weapon and armour training. Two martial weapons of choice, light and medium armour (all covered by the Fighter already).

Critical Strike (Martial, Fighter 1st-level feat). Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a natural 20, or on a natural 19 that hits. A critical adds the maximum of the weapon's damage dice.

Steady Hand (General, Human bonus feat). +1 Strength, moved to Wisdom by the starting cap of 18 (included). Advantage on checks to resist being disarmed, knocked Prone or moved against your will.

Notes. Speed: 30ft · Initiative: +1 · HP: d10 max (10) + Con mod (+2) = 12. Untrained NWPs are rolled with Disadvantage; everyday checks (notice, climb, intimidate) are plain attribute checks.

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 4 (Cuir Bouille, Medium) + 1 (Dex, Medium max +2) + 1 (Buckler) = 16

Class Abilities

1st Level

  • Weapon Specialisation: Choose one weapon — you have Advantage on the first attack roll you make with it each round, and gain +1 damage with it.
  • Improves to +2 damage at 7th level
  • Improves to +3 damage at 19th level
  • At 13th level, choose a second weapon to specialise in, or add a further +1 damage to your first

1st Level — Combat Manoeuvres

  • Combat Manoeuvres: Every character can use every manoeuvre; the Fighter's edge is Manoeuvre Mastery. See the Combat Manoeuvres section for details.
  • Combat Reflexes: You have the Combat Reflexes feat for free (see The Feats of Arneyan in Character Creation). It doesn't use a feat slot.

4th Level — Combat Dominance

  • Combat Dominance: When every creature you attack this round is of Level up to half yours, you can make extra attacks, split among them as you like.
  • 4th level: 2 attacks per round against creatures of Level up to half your level
  • 8th level: 3 attacks per round against creatures of Level up to half your level
  • 12th level: 4 attacks per round against creatures of Level up to half your level
  • All but the first attack are rolled with Disadvantage. Combat Dominance replaces the Extra Attack and the off-hand attack; Flowing Strikes can still add one.

7th Level — Manoeuvre Mastery

  • Manoeuvre Mastery: Manoeuvres that impose disadvantage on your own attack roll (Shield Blow) are now rolled normally, with no disadvantage.
  • 13th level: Contest-based manoeuvres (Trip, Disarm, Dirty Trick) are now rolled with advantage.
  • 19th level: Manoeuvres that previously imposed disadvantage on your attack roll are now rolled with advantage instead.

7th Level — Extra Attack

  • Extra Attack: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • Does not stack with Combat Dominance — choose one or the other each round

13th Level — Battle Space

  • Battle Space: You control the space around you in ways most fighters never learn.
  • +1 AC at 13th unless wielding a two-handed weapon

14th Level — Shield Mastery

  • Shield Mastery: Use a shield as a second weapon without the normal two-weapon attack penalty. It is a Light weapon dealing 1d4 (1d6 for a Tower Shield), and it keeps its AC bonus.

15th Level — Strength Bonus

  • Strength Bonus: Gain a permanent +1 to Strength.

17th Level — Battle Space (Improved)

  • Battle Space (Improved): Your mastery of positioning deepens.
  • Once per encounter, when you attack, you also gain the benefit of Dodge until your next turn
  • Flank Attack grants advantage on the attack roll and +2 damage
  • A Flank Attack also deals +1 damage die

19th Level — Attribute Bonus

  • Attribute Bonus: Gain a permanent +1 to either Strength or Dexterity.

20th Level — Legend of Battle

  • Legend of Battle: Once per day, for 1 minute you become a force of war that lesser fighters can only dream of.
  • All attack rolls are made with advantage for the duration
  • Every hit deals maximum damage — no rolling
  • Enemies that can see you must make a Will save (Class Save DC) at the start of each of their turns or be frightened for 1 round

22nd Level — Battle Space (Master)

  • Battle Space (Master): You move through combat like water — nothing holds you and nothing catches you.
  • When you attack, you may also Disengage from any number of enemies as part of the same action
  • Dodge lasts until the start of your next turn, and while it lasts you also have Advantage on Reflex saves
  • A Flank Attack deals +2 damage dice instead, and the target cannot make Attacks of Opportunity against you until the start of your next turn

24th Level — Unbroken

  • Unbroken: Once per encounter, when reduced to 0 HP or below, immediately stand at 1 HP.
  • No save, no check — pure will
  • For the next round you are immune to all damage
  • All your attacks during that round deal +2 damage dice
  • After that round normal rules resume

Combat Manoeuvres

Every manoeuvre in the Combat Manoeuvres section is available to the Fighter from 1st level, and Mastery tiers unlock at 7th, 13th and 19th level (see Class Abilities). The Fighter also has one manoeuvre of their own:

Kits

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Fighter folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Kits represent your fighting tradition, background, and the culture that forged you.

Traits

  • Choose one skill at creation; you have Advantage on checks with it. This is not a Proficiency tier and does not take an NWP slot.
  • Gains an additional Feat from the General Path (The Survivors) at 1st level, on top of their normal 1st-level Feat choice.
  • Weapon training: any two martial weapons of choice.
  • Armour training: light, medium.
